words.method: At each transect, measure the bankfull height above the present water surface in m, with a rod at the water's edge and a clinometer held level at bankfull. Value: mean of the 11 heights.

describe.None: Percent of the streambed that is sand or finer; higher is worse.

describe.None: Mean residual pool depth; higher is better.

words.method: Measure thalweg depth at 10 or 15 evenly spaced stations between each pair of transects (100 or 150 per reach). Value: mean residual pool depth in cm, from that profile and the reach slope (NRSA physical habitat calculations).

describe.None: Percent of the watershed in impervious surface; higher is worse.

words.method: Percent of the delineated watershed in impervious surface, computed by DEEP. No field measurement.

describe.None: Mean bankfull width over mean bankfull depth; both high and low values score lower.
describe: Mean bankfull width over mean bankfull depth; both high and low values score lower.
describe.10_to_100: Mean bankfull width over mean bankfull depth; both high and low values score lower.
describe.gt_100: Mean bankfull width over mean bankfull depth; both high and low values score lower.

words.method: At each transect, measure bankfull width, bankfull height above the water surface and thalweg depth. Value: mean bankfull width divided by mean bankfull depth (bankfull height plus thalweg depth).

describe.None: Mean bankfull height above the water surface; both high and low values score lower.

words.method: At each transect, measure the bankfull height above the present water surface in m, with a rod at the water's edge and a clinometer held level at bankfull. Value: mean of the 11 heights.

describe.None: Percent of the streambed that is sand or finer; higher is worse.

words.method: Record the particle size class at 5 evenly spaced points on each of the 11 transects and the 10 cross-sections midway between them (105 particles). Value: percent sand or finer.

describe.None: Percent of the coarse bed buried in fine sediment; higher is worse.

words.method: At 5 evenly spaced points on each of the 11 transects, estimate the percent of the particle buried in sand or finer sediment. Value: mean of the 55 estimates.

describe.None: Mean bankfull width over mean bankfull depth; both high and low values score lower.
describe: Mean bankfull width over mean bankfull depth; both high and low values score lower.
describe.10_to_100: Mean bankfull width over mean bankfull depth; both high and low values score lower.
describe.gt_100: Mean bankfull width over mean bankfull depth; both high and low values score lower.

words.method: At each transect, measure bankfull width, bankfull height above the water surface and thalweg depth. Value: mean bankfull width divided by mean bankfull depth (bankfull height plus thalweg depth).

describe.None: Mean bankfull height above the water surface; both high and low values score lower.

words.method: At each transect, measure the bankfull height above the present water surface in m, with a rod at the water's edge and a clinometer held level at bankfull. Value: mean of the 11 heights.

describe.None: Channel length over straight line length (sinuosity); higher is better.

words.method: Take a compass backsight bearing and the distance between each pair of neighboring transects. Value: channel length along those segments divided by the straight-line distance between the reach ends.

describe.None: Mean bank angle; both high and low values score lower.

words.method: On both banks of each transect, lay a pole about 1 m long against the bank and read its angle from horizontal with a clinometer, in degrees. Value: mean of the 22 readings.

describe.None: Bed particle size against what bankfull flow can move (log); both high and low values score lower.

words.method: Computed: the base 10 log of the geometric mean particle diameter divided by the largest diameter the bankfull flow can move, from the particle count, reach slope, bankfull depth, wood tally and residual pools (NRSA physical habitat calculations).

describe.None: Percent of the streambed that is sand or finer; higher is worse.

words.method: Record the particle size class at 5 evenly spaced points on each of the 11 transects and the 10 cross-sections midway between them (105 particles). Value: percent sand or finer.

describe.None: Mean bed particle size (log mm); higher is better.

words.method: From the 105-particle size class count (as for sand and fines). Value: base 10 log of the geometric mean particle diameter in mm, from the size classes (NRSA physical habitat calculations).

describe.None: Volume of large wood per 100 m of channel; higher is better.

words.method: Between each pair of transects, tally every piece of wood at least 10 cm in diameter and 1.5 m long in or above the bankfull channel, by length and diameter class. Value: wood volume per 100 m of channel, from the tally.

describe.None: Chlorophyll a in the stream water, a measure of algae; higher is worse.

words.method: Water-column chlorophyll a (µg/L) from a 2 L mid-channel grab sample at the X-site, collected in an amber bottle, filtered and analyzed in a lab.

describe.None: Canopy density over the middle of the channel; higher is better.
describe: Canopy density over the middle of the channel; higher is better.
describe.le_10: Canopy density over the middle of the channel; higher is better.
describe.10_to_100: Canopy density over the middle of the channel; higher is better.
describe.gt_100: Canopy density over the middle of the channel; higher is better.

words.method: At mid-channel on each transect, read a convex spherical densiometer facing upstream, downstream, left and right (covered points of 17). Value: mean of the 44 readings, as a percent.

describe.None: Woody vegetation cover in the riparian canopy, understory and ground layer; higher is better.

words.method: In a 10 m by 10 m plot on each bank at each transect, estimate the areal cover class of woody vegetation in the canopy, understory and ground layer. Value: summed woody cover of the 3 layers, averaged over the 22 plots, as a fraction.

describe.None: Total nitrogen in the stream water; higher is worse.

words.method: Total nitrogen (mg N/L), lab analysis of the unfiltered mid-channel grab sample from the X-site, kept on ice.

describe.None: Total phosphorus in the stream water; higher is worse.

words.method: Total phosphorus (µg/L), lab analysis of the mid-channel grab sample from the X-site, kept on ice.

describe.None: Turbidity of the stream water; higher is worse.

words.method: Turbidity (NTU), lab analysis of the mid-channel grab sample from the X-site. Sample before anyone walks the channel upstream.

describe.None: Specific conductance of the stream water; higher is worse.

words.method: Specific conductance (µS/cm). NRSA reports the lab value of a mid-channel grab sample at the X-site (the reach center); a calibrated multi-parameter meter reads the same quantity in the stream there.

describe.None: Percent of the reach in riffles and other fast water; higher is better.

words.method: At each thalweg station, record the channel unit (falls, cascade, rapid, riffle, glide, pool, dry). Value: percent of stations in falls, cascade, rapid or riffle.

describe.None: Areal cover of natural fish cover in the channel; higher is better.
describe: Areal cover of natural fish cover in the channel; higher is better.
describe.10_to_100: Areal cover of natural fish cover in the channel; higher is better.
describe.gt_100: Areal cover of natural fish cover in the channel; higher is better.

words.method: In the 10 m of channel centered on each transect, estimate the areal cover class of each fish cover type on the form (wood, brush, overhanging vegetation, undercut banks, boulders, others). Value: summed cover of the natural types, averaged over the transects.

describe.None: Number of benthic macroinvertebrate taxa; higher is better.

words.method: From the 11-transect composite D-frame sample (500 µm mesh) and its lab subsample. Value: total number of taxa.

words.method: Electrofish the reach upstream through every habitat between the transects, identifying and counting every fish. Value: number of native taxa.

describe.None: Shannon diversity of the benthic macroinvertebrate sample; higher is better.

words.method: From the 11-transect composite D-frame sample (500 µm mesh) and its lab subsample. Value: Shannon diversity of the taxa counted.

words.method: From the 11-transect composite D-frame sample (500 µm mesh) and its lab subsample. Value: percent of individuals in pollution-tolerant taxa.

describe.None: Percent of streamflow that comes from base flow; higher is better.

words.method: Percent of streamflow that comes from base flow in the watershed (USGS base flow index grid), read from EPA StreamCat for the reach. No field measurement.

describe.None: Upstream dam storage as a percent of mean annual runoff; higher is worse.

words.method: Normal storage of upstream dams as a percent of mean annual runoff, both read from EPA StreamCat for the reach. No field measurement.

describe.None: Percent of streamflow that comes from base flow; higher is better.

words.method: Percent of streamflow that comes from base flow in the watershed (USGS base flow index grid), read from EPA StreamCat for the reach. No field measurement.

describe.None: Mean residual pool depth; higher is better.

words.method: Measure thalweg depth at 10 or 15 evenly spaced stations between each pair of transects (100 or 150 per reach). Value: mean residual pool depth in cm, from that profile and the reach slope (NRSA physical habitat calculations).

describe.None: Percent of the watershed in impervious surface; higher is worse.

words.method: Percent of the delineated watershed in impervious surface, computed by DEEP. No field measurement.

describe.None: Mean bankfull width over mean bankfull depth; both high and low values score lower.

words.method: At each transect, measure bankfull width, bankfull height above the water surface and thalweg depth. Value: mean bankfull width divided by mean bankfull depth (bankfull height plus thalweg depth).

describe.None: Mean bankfull height above the water surface; both high and low values score lower.

words.method: At each transect, measure the bankfull height above the present water surface in m, with a rod at the water's edge and a clinometer held level at bankfull. Value: mean of the 11 heights.

describe.None: Percent of the streambed that is sand or finer; higher is worse.

words.method: Record the particle size class at 5 evenly spaced points on each of the 11 transects and the 10 cross-sections midway between them (105 particles). Value: percent sand or finer.

describe.None: Percent of the coarse bed buried in fine sediment; higher is worse.

words.method: At 5 evenly spaced points on each of the 11 transects, estimate the percent of the particle buried in sand or finer sediment. Value: mean of the 55 estimates.

describe.None: Mean bankfull width over mean bankfull depth; both high and low values score lower.

words.method: At each transect, measure bankfull width, bankfull height above the water surface and thalweg depth. Value: mean bankfull width divided by mean bankfull depth (bankfull height plus thalweg depth).

describe.None: Mean bankfull height above the water surface; both high and low values score lower.

words.method: At each transect, measure the bankfull height above the present water surface in m, with a rod at the water's edge and a clinometer held level at bankfull. Value: mean of the 11 heights.

describe.None: Channel length over straight line length (sinuosity); higher is better.

words.method: Take a compass backsight bearing and the distance between each pair of neighboring transects. Value: channel length along those segments divided by the straight-line distance between the reach ends.

describe.None: Mean bank angle; both high and low values score lower.

words.method: On both banks of each transect, lay a pole about 1 m long against the bank and read its angle from horizontal with a clinometer, in degrees. Value: mean of the 22 readings.

describe.None: Bed particle size against what bankfull flow can move (log); both high and low values score lower.

words.method: Computed: the base 10 log of the geometric mean particle diameter divided by the largest diameter the bankfull flow can move, from the particle count, reach slope, bankfull depth, wood tally and residual pools (NRSA physical habitat calculations).

describe.None: Percent of the streambed that is sand or finer; higher is worse.

words.method: Record the particle size class at 5 evenly spaced points on each of the 11 transects and the 10 cross-sections midway between them (105 particles). Value: percent sand or finer.

describe.None: Mean bed particle size (log mm); higher is better.

words.method: From the 105-particle size class count (as for sand and fines). Value: base 10 log of the geometric mean particle diameter in mm, from the size classes (NRSA physical habitat calculations).

describe.None: Percent of the coarse bed buried in fine sediment; higher is worse.

words.method: At 5 evenly spaced points on each of the 11 transects, estimate the percent of the particle buried in sand or finer sediment. Value: mean of the 55 estimates.

describe.None: Chlorophyll a in the stream water, a measure of algae; higher is worse.

words.method: Water-column chlorophyll a (µg/L) from a 2 L mid-channel grab sample at the X-site, collected in an amber bottle, filtered and analyzed in a lab.

describe.None: Canopy density over the middle of the channel; higher is better.

words.method: At mid-channel on each transect, read a convex spherical densiometer facing upstream, downstream, left and right (covered points of 17). Value: mean of the 44 readings, as a percent.

describe.None: Woody vegetation cover in the riparian canopy, understory and ground layer; higher is better.

words.method: In a 10 m by 10 m plot on each bank at each transect, estimate the areal cover class of woody vegetation in the canopy, understory and ground layer. Value: summed woody cover of the 3 layers, averaged over the 22 plots, as a fraction.

describe.None: Total nitrogen in the stream water; higher is worse.

words.method: Total nitrogen (mg N/L), lab analysis of the unfiltered mid-channel grab sample from the X-site, kept on ice.

describe.None: Total phosphorus in the stream water; higher is worse.

words.method: Total phosphorus (µg/L), lab analysis of the mid-channel grab sample from the X-site, kept on ice.

describe.None: Specific conductance of the stream water; higher is worse.

words.method: Specific conductance (µS/cm). NRSA reports the lab value of a mid-channel grab sample at the X-site (the reach center); a calibrated multi-parameter meter reads the same quantity in the stream there.

describe.None: Turbidity of the stream water; higher is worse.

words.method: Turbidity (NTU), lab analysis of the mid-channel grab sample from the X-site. Sample before anyone walks the channel upstream.

describe.None: Percent of the reach in riffles and other fast water; higher is better.
describe: Percent of the reach in riffles and other fast water; higher is better.
describe.lt_0.5: Percent of the reach in riffles and other fast water; higher is better.

describe.None: Areal cover of natural fish cover in the channel; higher is better.

words.method: In the 10 m of channel centered on each transect, estimate the areal cover class of each fish cover type on the form (wood, brush, overhanging vegetation, undercut banks, boulders, others). Value: summed cover of the natural types, averaged over the transects.

describe.None: Number of benthic macroinvertebrate taxa; higher is better.

words.method: From the 11-transect composite D-frame sample (500 µm mesh) and its lab subsample. Value: total number of taxa.

describe.None: Number of native fish taxa; higher is better.

words.method: Electrofish the reach upstream through every habitat between the transects, identifying and counting every fish. Value: number of native taxa.

describe.None: Number of mayfly, stonefly and caddisfly taxa; higher is better.

words.method: From the 11-transect composite D-frame sample (500 µm mesh) and its lab subsample. Value: Shannon diversity of the taxa counted.

describe.None: Chlorophyll a in the stream water, a measure of algae; higher is worse.

words.method: Water-column chlorophyll a (µg/L) from a 2 L mid-channel grab sample at the X-site, collected in an amber bottle, filtered and analyzed in a lab.

describe.None: Woody vegetation cover in the riparian canopy, understory and ground layer; higher is better.

words.method: In a 10 m by 10 m plot on each bank at each transect, estimate the areal cover class of woody vegetation in the canopy, understory and ground layer. Value: summed woody cover of the 3 layers, averaged over the 22 plots, as a fraction.

describe.None: Total nitrogen in the stream water; higher is worse.

words.method: Total nitrogen (mg N/L), lab analysis of the unfiltered mid-channel grab sample from the X-site, kept on ice.

describe.None: Total phosphorus in the stream water; higher is worse.

words.method: Total phosphorus (µg/L), lab analysis of the mid-channel grab sample from the X-site, kept on ice.

describe.None: Specific conductance of the stream water; higher is worse.

words.method: Specific conductance (µS/cm). NRSA reports the lab value of a mid-channel grab sample at the X-site (the reach center); a calibrated multi-parameter meter reads the same quantity in the stream there.

describe.None: Turbidity of the stream water; higher is worse.

words.method: Turbidity (NTU), lab analysis of the mid-channel grab sample from the X-site. Sample before anyone walks the channel upstream.

describe.None: Areal cover of natural fish cover in the channel; higher is better.

words.method: In the 10 m of channel centered on each transect, estimate the areal cover class of each fish cover type on the form (wood, brush, overhanging vegetation, undercut banks, boulders, others). Value: summed cover of the natural types, averaged over the transects.

describe.None: Percent of the reach in riffles and other fast water; higher is better.

words.method: At each thalweg station, record the channel unit (falls, cascade, rapid, riffle, glide, pool, dry). Value: percent of stations in falls, cascade, rapid or riffle.

describe.None: Number of native fish taxa that are not pollution tolerant; higher is better.

words.method: From the upstream electrofishing pass over every habitat between the transects (every fish identified and counted). Value: number of native taxa not classed tolerant.

describe.None: EPA's fish multimetric index (0 to 100); higher is better.

words.method: Computed: from the upstream electrofishing pass (every habitat between the transects, every fish identified and counted), score EPA's 8 regional fish metrics, several adjusted for watershed area, and rescale to 0 to 100 (NRSA 2018-19 technical support document).

describe.None: Number of mayfly, stonefly and caddisfly taxa; higher is better.

words.method: Take a D-frame net sample (500 µm mesh) 1 m downstream of each of the 11 transects at the assigned left, center or right station, and composite them. A lab identifies a fixed-count subsample. Value: number of mayfly, stonefly and caddisfly taxa.

describe.None: EPA's benthic macroinvertebrate multimetric index (0 to 100); higher is better.

words.method: Computed: from the 11-transect composite D-frame sample (500 µm mesh) and its fixed-count lab subsample, score EPA's 6 regional benthic metrics against the published floors and ceilings and rescale the sum to 0 to 100 (NRSA 2018-19 technical support document).

describe: Bed particle size against what bankfull flow can move (log); both high and low values score lower.

describe.gt_100: Bed particle size against what bankfull flow can move (log); both high and low values score lower.

words.method: Computed: the base 10 log of the geometric mean particle diameter divided by the largest diameter the bankfull flow can move, from the particle count, reach slope, bankfull depth, wood tally and residual pools (NRSA physical habitat calculations).

describe.None: Percent of the streambed that is sand or finer; higher is worse.

describe.None: Chlorophyll a in the stream water, a measure of algae; higher is worse.

describe.gt_100: Canopy density over the middle of the channel; higher is better.

words.method: pH of the X-site mid-channel grab sample, as NRSA reports it, or a calibrated multi-parameter meter reading in the stream there at 0.5 m depth (mid-depth if shallower).

describe.None: Turbidity of the stream water; higher is worse.

words.method: Turbidity (NTU), lab analysis of the mid-channel grab sample from the X-site. Sample before anyone walks the channel upstream.

describe.None: Percent of the reach in riffles and other fast water; higher is better.

words.method: At each thalweg station, record the channel unit (falls, cascade, rapid, riffle, glide, pool, dry). Value: percent of stations in falls, cascade, rapid or riffle.

describe.None: Areal cover of natural fish cover in the channel; higher is better.

words.method: In the 10 m of channel centered on each transect, estimate the areal cover class of each fish cover type on the form (wood, brush, overhanging vegetation, undercut banks, boulders, others). Value: summed cover of the natural types, averaged over the transects.

describe.None: Number of native fish taxa; higher is better.

words.method: Electrofish the reach upstream through every habitat between the transects, identifying and counting every fish. Value: number of native taxa.

describe.None: Number of benthic macroinvertebrate taxa; higher is better.

words.method: From the 11-transect composite D-frame sample (500 µm mesh) and its lab subsample. Value: total number of taxa.

describe.None: Shannon diversity of the benthic macroinvertebrate sample; higher is better.

words.method: From the 11-transect composite D-frame sample (500 µm mesh) and its lab subsample. Value: Shannon diversity of the taxa counted.

describe.None: Percent of benthic macroinvertebrate individuals in pollution tolerant taxa; higher is worse.

words.method: From the 11-transect composite D-frame sample (500 µm mesh) and its lab subsample. Value: percent of individuals in pollution-tolerant taxa.

describe.None: Mapped dams within one mile of the site; higher is worse.

words.method: Dams in the USACE National Inventory of Dams within 1 mile of the site, counted by DEEP. Note in the field any barrier the inventory does not show.
